citations.source_line: Current native authority is zero. Static inspection, graph construction, ordinary reference work, and approved source-static public IR construction/serialization are distinct from executing the SDK. SDK relation/circuit checks, model/degree queries, VM/transcript execution, native key generation, proving, native verification and ledger actions remain blocked. Source-static compilation is not permission to invoke those operations. Opus additionally classifies signed `verify-intent --profile`, `simulate --trace --target` and the CLI replay generator as blocked where they invoke SDK checks or degree queries; pure Core reference APIs are a separate surface (see `SECURITY-REVIEW.md`, section 4). Use only inspected safe ordinary checks under their existing authority; this planning review ran no product tests. Actual Fenrir target identity/configuration and other unavailable external facts are separate blockers. Unknown target facts are not invented and do not block independent language work.
